general_refinement.trigger: A review proposes changing full reading order despite usable proof-entry links.
general_refinement.action: Assess complete route separately from shortcut entry; enumerate deferred contracts and proof-discharge destinations before relocation.
general_refinement.check: Every retained promised proof still has a destination; the next main-route operation has a complete usable contract.
general_refinement.reason: A correct interface resolves an absence claim without necessarily resolving the cost of the default reading order.
general_refinement.exception: An expert-facing short statement may best remain early; chronology may lead when chronology is the subject. No universal construction-first mandate.

transfer_cases.assessment: Source-grounded author check: contact/curvature full-support route closes before the circuit branch; positive density and fixed-word second moments have separate dependencies. Existing entry links do not permit promoting support alone into a complete circuit proof.
transfer_cases.outcome: Refinement distinguishes independent proof access from full dependency closure.
